basic_details.job_title: DCWSS Social Worker Member Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Social Worker Member of the Children Welfare Committee is open, and filled-in applications must reach the department on or before 5.00 PM on 22 December 2026. The Department of Children Welfare and Special Services, Government of Tamil Nadu, has invited the applications under Section 4 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 and the Rules therein, and the application format is on the departmental website dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in.

qualification.details: The applicant must meet one of the following: | Should have been actively involved in health, education or welfare activities pertaining to children for at least seven years, OR Should be a practicing professional with a degree in Child Psychology, Psychiatry, Sociology or Law. | The post is on an honorarium basis. The notice does not mention the amount of the honorarium. | For further eligibility details, candidates should refer to the official notification and the departmental website.

content_sections.heading: TN Children Welfare Department Social Worker Member at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee, the amount of the honorarium or the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many Social Worker Member vacancies are advertised?
faq.answer: The Department of Children Welfare and Special Services has advertised 1 post of Social Worker Member of the Children Welfare Committee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: Filled-in applications must reach the department on or before 5.00 PM on 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: The applicant should have been actively involved in health, education or welfare activities pertaining to children for at least seven years, or be a practicing professional with a degree in Child Psychology, Psychiatry, Sociology or Law.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be not less than 35 years of age and should not have completed 65 years on the date of notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Social Worker Member?
faq.answer: The post is on an honorarium basis; the advertisement does not print an amount.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I get the Social Worker Member application form?
faq.answer: The application format and further eligibility details are on the departmental website, https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in.

faq.question: Q7. Can a practicing lawyer apply for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: Yes, a practicing professional with a degree in Law is eligible, as are practicing professionals with a degree in Child Psychology, Psychiatry or Sociology, subject to the age limit of 35 years to below 65 years.

faq.question: Q8. Under which law is the Social Worker Member appointed?
faq.answer: Applications are invited as per Section 4 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 and the Rules therein.
